_README: What the page says about each document: its title and its authors.
The pipeline records a title per document in stage0_documents.json, and for
14 of the 22 it is the real one. For the rest it picked up a masthead, an
advertisement or a keyword list, because that is what the top of those pages
holds. It records no authors at all. Both are read here off the first page of
each document. A citation carrying a wrong title or author is worse than one
A file with no entry falls back to its recorded title, and a document with no
usable title falls back to its filename; no authors means none are shown.
Adding to the corpus never requires editing this file, it only lets you
improve what a reader sees. Periodicals have no authors: the issue is the work.
